issues: Admin panel appears minimal - only shows 'SYSTEM STATUS' section with basic text. May need more admin features like blocked words management, settings controls.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js is very large (2000+ lines) - consider splitting into separate component files for maintainability
ESLint warnings about missing dependencies in useEffect hooks (lines 290, 732, 843, 1009) - not critical but should be addressed
